content: Aɣelleb n Abiya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, x Yarubɛam
Deg useggʷas wiss tmenṭac n ujeǧid Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, idweř Abiya d ajeǧid x Yahuda.
Netta iḥkem třata n iseggʷusa di Urcalim. Yemmas qqaren as Mixa-Yahu, yeǧis n Uriyil zi Jibɛa. Tuɣa din umenɣi jar Abiya d Yarubɛam.
Abiya issekkar amenɣi s ijj n řɛeskar n ayt n bu-teɣruḍt imeḥḍen, arebɛa-myat-ařef n yeryazen ittwafarzen, uca Yarubɛam igga aseddi s temn-myat-ařef n yeryazen ittwafarzen, ayt n bu-teɣruḍt imeḥḍen.
Ibedd Abiya x tqiccat n wedrar n Ṣamarayim nni iǧan x idurar n Ifrayim, inna: “Sřem ɣari, Yarubɛam d marra Israil!
Ma war tessinem ca aqa SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, iwca tagelda x Israil s yijj n řɛahd n tmeǧaḥt i Dawud u i iḥenjiren nnes i řebda?
Maca Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, amsexxar n Suliman, mmis n Dawud, ikkar uca iɣewweɣ x sidis nnes.
Iryazen ixwan, ayt i war isekkwin, usin-dd ɣares uca ssjehden ixef nsen ḍidd i Raḥabɛam, mmis n Suliman, umi Raḥabɛam tuɣa ɛad d ameẓyan d aḥnin n wuř u war izemmar akidsen imqudda.

Uca řexxu, ittɣiř awem ad tiřim tjehdem x tgeldit n SIDI, tenni iǧan deg ifassen n iḥenjiren n Dawud. Waxxa, kenniw s yijj n řɣaci ameqqran i teǧam, maca ɣarwem iɛejmiyyen n wureɣ nni igga Yarubɛam d irebbiten i kenniw.

Ma war tenḍarem kenniw ikehhanen n SIDI, arraw n Harun d warraw n Lawi, u teggim i yixef nwem ikehhanen am mammec tt tteggen řegnus di marra timmura? Marra wenni dd-yusin s yijj n ufunas, ameẓyan n tfunast, u s sebɛa n icarriyyen i ixsen ad ittwagg d akehhan, aqa idweř d akehhan n yinni war iǧin ca d irebbiten.
Maca xaneɣ, aqa SIDI d AREBBI nneɣ, u neccin war xas nḥeyyed ca, u ikehhanen nni isexxaren i SIDI, aqa aten d arraw n Harun, u Ilawiyyen bedden akidsen di řxedmet.

Kuř ṣṣbeḥ d tmeddit ssbexxaran tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ i SIDI. Uca ḥḍan ɛawed x řebxur ittfuḥen d usettef n weɣrum n wescan x tzewḍa tezdeg u x řqendiř n wureɣ u x řefnarat, ḥima ad tent ssarɣen kuř tameddit, maɣar neccin nxezzar ɣar tsexxart n SIDI, AREBBI nneɣ, maca kenniw tḥeyydem xas.

Xzarem, AREBBI aqa-t akidneɣ ɣar zzatneɣ, u ɣarneɣ uřa d ikehhanen nnes ak-d řebwaq i usuḍi s wesruddeḥ, maḥend ad daysen suḍen s wesruddeḥ. A ayt n Israil, war ttmenɣam ca ak-d SIDI, AREBBI n řejdud nwem, maɣar kenniw war tfřiḥim ca.”
Maca Yarubɛam ijja ict n tesɣart n yeryazen nnes ad ggen ict n ddura maḥend ad ggen taxceft ɣar ḍeffar nsen. Nitni tuɣa aten zzat i wudem n Yahuda, u ɣar ḍeffar n yeryazen n Yahuda tuɣa din řfex.
Umi nqeřben ayt n Yahuda, ẓrin, aqa amenɣi tuɣa-t zi zzat d zi ḍeffar. Nitni sɣuyen ɣar SIDI uca suḍen ikehhanen di řebwaq.
Iryazen n Yahuda ssgeɛɛden deg iɣuyyan n umenɣi u řami ssgeɛɛden iryazen n Yahuda deg iɣuyyan, imsar, aqa AREBBI iwta Yarubɛam d marra Israil zzat i tiṭṭawin n Abiya d Yahuda.
Arrawen n Israil arewřen zzat i wudem n Yahuda uca AREBBI igga i-ten deg ufus nsen.
Abiya ak-d řgens nnes, wtin ten s ict n tecti d tameqqrant, minzi wḍan zzaysen xemsa-myat-ařef n yeryazen ittwafarzen zi Israil.
Ammu i dewřen ayt n Israil nnbehtřen di řweqt nni, maca ayt n Yahuda dewřen jehden, minzi ttecřen x SIDI, AREBBI n řejdud nsen.
Abiya iḍfar Yarubɛam uca iṭṭef zzayes tineddam Bayt-Il ak-d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen, Yacana ak-d dcurat nnes d Ifrun ak-d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen.
War teqqim ɛad jjehd ɣar Yarubɛam deg wussan n Abiya. Ɣar uneggar iwta i-t SIDI, ařami immut.
Abiya maca idweř yarenni di jjehd. Netta yiwi arbeɛṭac n temɣarin i yixef nnes u ijja-dd tnayen u-ɛicrin n warrawen d seṭṭac n yessis.
Min iqqimen n imezruyen n Abiya, am tebridin nnes am wawařen nnes, aqa man aya marra ittwazemmem deg wedlis n tɣuri n unabi Ɛiddu.
Abiya igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes uca neḍřen t di tendint n Dawud, uca mmis Asa idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes. Deg wussan nnes tuɣa din ɛecra n iseggʷusa n řhudnet di temmurt.
